reviews.t: I don't like the knobs on the side
reviews.x: Lots of options, the diffuser is large, there are 2 different sized flat blowers. I don't like the knobs on the side, I always hit them with my hand while blow drying. It's light, quiet. The hang up dealy is stable not a flimsy plastic circle, it is part of the plastic.

reviews.t: OMG it’s amazing! I was a little concerned about the small ...
reviews.x: So I read tons of reviews before purchasing a hair dryer. I settled on this one. OMG it’s amazing! I was a little concerned about the small opening to blow air until I used it! It is POWERFUL! I have thick straight hair almost to my butt. Literally dried my hair in less than 5 minutes! Highly recommend. Also came with several cool attachments.

I only use the narrow air attachment.  It it amazing at how much power this dryer has. It dries my hair super fast.  My hair looks so smooth.  I love the adde

reviews.t: Good dryer, attachments don't attach though.
reviews.x: Okay, great blow dryer, except three of the four attachments don't click on. The long concentrator nozzle is the only one that will fit. The rest just don't click on at all. I have naturally curly hair, so it would have been nice to have the diffuser attachment actually attach.

This is the best purchase i've made in awhile. I had bought a nice looking dryer off Ebay and it turned out to be frying my hair with every use. I bought this and my hair is absolutely not as dry and brittle as it was. Now it's soft and healthier even when using heat. Big big difference!!! It's a good hair dryer, and you get all the hair accessories as well.

Very nice dryer.. good price to have it ,received my hair dryer yesteed and i love it. the quality is great, better than quit a few of dryers that i have purchased in the past. I like the fact that there is a cool setting on this device, because if I don't want to use heat protection oil I'll adjust the setting to cool. All of the attachments work great. My only disappointment is that there isn't another comb attachment just one. But all in all it is a good product.

Dry my hair fast even if it is adjusted to medium heat and speed, this allows to evenly dry hair without burning it. Also come with enough attachments, the diffuser attachment preserve the curls or lift the root area to add volumn to your hair.

reviews.t: really like it, i have processed hair
reviews.x: used once now, really like it, i have processed hair, so i need a gentler hair dryer with end nozzle and the diffuser is nice bonus. you can turn the wind down and have  great hot or warm air. It definitely polishes a bit better than my old dryer. no hair dryer is a miracle, your hair is your hair, but, cut the wind down a notch and have a great tip on the end, (that stays put!) helps. the only negative so far is that the cool shot,(which is great of course) is very touchy. its in the same place

reviews.t: It is a awesome product! I have been using it everyday
reviews.x: It is a awesome product! I have been using it everyday. It is a perfect size for me, not heavy at all. Just what I wanted. I have medium length hair, it dries hair quickly, leaving it sleek, shiny, and frizz-free. I love the attachments, the comb is my favorite I can basically blow dry my hair straight with out a brush!

reviews.t: its not a bad choice for a blow dryer
reviews.x: So far, its not a bad choice for a blow dryer, love the attachments that come with it. Not a bad price overall. Have used it for over a week, awaiting the results of changing my hair from being stripped and dried out for the winter time but overall I liked it.

reviews.t: Made my hair oily and very tangled
reviews.x: Got this dryer because of all the good reviews, and returned it. It tangled up my hair so bad, and made it very oily. I didn’t change any hair products or shampoo. It was definitely the dryer. It did dry my hair quickly, but not worth the tangled oily mess.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the dryer's powerful airflow and fast drying, even on thick or long hair.
Several reviewers report problems with attachments not staying on or clicking into place.
Some reviewers complain about accidentally hitting the side knobs or buttons while drying.
A few reviewers mention heat concerns, ranging from not enough heat to a dangerous overheating incident.
Reviewers frequently highlight the diffuser and multiple attachments as a key selling point.
